csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; public class FixMaterials { public static void Execute() { for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) { var mat = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>($"Assets/DavidJalbert/LowPolyPeople/FBX/Materials/palette{i}.mat"); var tex = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>($"Assets/DavidJalbert/LowPolyPeople/FBX/Textures/palette{i}.png"); if (mat != null && tex != null) { mat.SetTexture("_BaseMap", tex); mat.SetColor("_BaseColor", Color.white); mat.EnableKeyword("_EMISSION"); mat.globalIlluminationFlags = MaterialGlobalIlluminationFlags.RealtimeEmissive; EditorUtility.SetDirty(mat); Debug.Log($"Fixed palette{i}"); } } AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); } }
